sections.purpose: Install the case and the thesis: a documented federal intelligence operation against lawful civic institutions, inside a functioning legal order — the coexistence is the object. Define *authoritarian capacity* (coinage marked).
sections.title: The Conspiracy

sections.purpose: The 20th-century image (tanks, coups) misleads; backsliding is executive aggrandizement under legal forms; the risk is composition of individually legal parts.
sections.title: The Wrong Picture of How Democracy Dies

sections.purpose: Legibility is the root of state capacity (Scott); the digital shift is from identifiability to patternability — *behavioral legibility*, marked as this essay's extension.
sections.title: To Govern Is First to See

sections.purpose: No central eye; a modular public-private ecosystem (plate readers, purchased location data, facial search) whose danger is scale + searchability + fusion-readiness. Includes the gait/Bluetooth correction (report against interest).
sections.title: The Distributed Panopticon

sections.purpose: Integration is the defining technology: relational queries none of the datasets contained; capacity grows combinatorially; spyware closes the endpoint; *Chatrie* shows doctrine adapting behind the curve — lag, not absence.
sections.title: The Fusion Layer

sections.purpose: Surveillance becomes political through classification: NSPM-7's ideological threads as investigative predicates; the act→network shift; Puppet Master as the shift made operational ("The Conspiracy" returns).
sections.title: From Seeing to Naming

sections.purpose: Terrorism law converts naming into exception. Precision: no standalone domestic-terrorism offense, no domestic FTO regime; §§2339A/B; *Holder*; why "Antifa is a terrorist organization" still matters administratively. Britain (Palestine Action) shows what the missing statute would do — the step not yet taken, and why preserving that distinction matters.
sections.title: The Most Powerful Word

sections.purpose: Fraenkel's normative/prerogative coexistence as analogy of structure; the measurable question (where is legal protection thin?); immigration as the answer: Khalil (citizenship as gradient of political vulnerability), citizen spillover, process punishment, the LA deployment and its judicial rebuke.
sections.title: The Dual State and Its Laboratory

sections.purpose: Steelman-adjacent history: Palmer (real violence → ideological generalization → mass enforcement), COINTELPRO ("disrupt and discredit"), post-9/11 Muslim surveillance with measured participation effects. Bipartisan lesson: capacity is inherited; the variable is leadership.
sections.title: The American Precedent Is America

sections.purpose: The named steelman ("haven't we always done this?") answered: continuity conceded in full, then the break located in economics — scale, persistence, granularity, integration, automation, retrospectivity, marginal cost, ideological direction, enforcement resources. "Armies of agents become a query."
sections.title: What Is Actually New

sections.purpose: The panopticon properly understood (uncertainty, not omniscience); chilling evidence (Stoycheff) *with* the AJPS complication conceded (report against interest); the strategic-environment reframe; "the perfect chilling effect leaves no defendant."
sections.title: Surveillance Without Arrest

sections.purpose: Tocqueville (association as the mother science) + Arendt (acting in concert) + Shklar (fear of arbitrary power): surveillance of association reaches the generative mechanism of democratic power; the liberal question becomes "what must I reasonably fear if I speak?"
sections.title: The Politics of Association

sections.purpose: The limits section, stated in the essay's own voice: what America is not; ICE is not the Gestapo (the better question substituted); courts consequential (*Chatrie*, Natanson, Perkins Coie); civil society powerful; Hungary's reversal as proof of contingency; then the falsifiable thresholds — the essay's own falsification condition (nine, compressed; Comey in one sentence as contested boundary).
sections.title: The Distance Between Danger and Dictatorship

sections.purpose: The pivot, philosophical not tactical: the "nothing to hide" retort steelmanned then answered; privacy as the condition of exploring, associating, organizing before announcing; the five-thinker synthesis; the explicit limits (not anonymity, not immunity from lawful investigation).
sections.title: The Democratic Right to Opacity

sections.purpose: Principles, not products: threat-model honestly; protect the endpoint; minimize ("whom besides me would this device expose?"); compartmentalize; organizational not individual; fear destroys trust horizontally; do not fetishize clandestinity — public legality is a weapon.
sections.title: A Security Culture for Democratic Life

sections.purpose: The climax: the paradox of democratic self-defense (the state must stay capable); design principles compressed into prose (predicate, purpose limitation, retention, audit, associational protection, vendor accountability, pluralism); friction as the constitutional ideal against the frictionless ideal of the surveillance industry; information architecture becomes constitutional architecture.
sections.title: What Must Power Not Know

sections.purpose: Return to the meeting: the person who decides not to attend; no knock, no case, the meeting one person smaller. Shklar/Arendt/Tocqueville return in compressed form; the final thesis in the persona's stated-fact register.
sections.title: Freedom Before the Knock (coda)

sections.purpose: Deliberately compact; three tiers compressed to short prose-plus-minimal-list; Tier 3 = "do not improvise; use professionals" with named organizations; links outward to living resources (EFF SSD, FPF, Access Now).
